title: CRISE-MG Single-center Retrospective Study of Patients Presenting With Myasthenic Crisis Admitted to the Medical Intensive Care
official: Single-center Retrospective Study of Patients Presenting With Myasthenic Crisis Admitted to the Medical Intensive Care Unit at Nice University Hospital Between December 2009 and September 2026
summary: This retrospective, single-center observational study will include approximately 102 adult patients with autoimmune myasthenia gravis who experienced at least one myasthenic crisis requiring admission to the intensive care unit (ICU) at Nice University Hospital between December 2009 and September 2026. The primary objective is to describe patients' demographic, clinical, and serological characteristics, maintenance treatments received during the six months preceding each crisis, the number of crises per patient, and documented precipitating factors. Secondary objectives include describing maintenance treatment patterns according to the precipitating factors of myasthenic crises, in order to characterize treatment profiles across different contexts, including intercurrent infections, spontaneous exacerbations, and poor treatment adherence. The analyses will be primarily descriptive and exploratory, with comparisons between groups where appropriate. No additional clinical examinations or biological samples will be required, and no direct clinical benefit is expected for the included patients.

interventions.name: Adults with Autoimmune Myasthenia Gravis Experiencing Myasthenic Crisis Requiring ICU Admission

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged 18 years or older
* Confirmed diagnosis of autoimmune myasthenia gravis, established before or during the hospitalization.
* At least one myasthenic crisis requiring admission to the intensive care unit at Nice University Hospital.
* Crisis occurring between December 2009 and September 2026.
* Medical records available to confirm eligibility and document the essential characteristics of the crisis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Autoimmune myasthenia gravis diagnosis not confirmed.
* Insufficient medical records to confirm a qualifying myasthenic crisis.
